name.value: Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites Penticton

description.value: A Marriott Fairfield Inn & Suites hotel in Penticton offering standard modern accommodation for traveling guests. Located on Eckhardt Avenue West, it provides a chain-hotel option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region. Bike storage and handling procedures remain unconfirmed.
